scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @askadia/web dev" "pnpm --filter @askadia/api dev" "pnpm --filter @askadia/worker dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @askadia/api build && pnpm --filter @askadia/worker build && pnpm --filter @askadia/web build
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
